name: Transcription Skill
description: Speech recognition: audio/video in, structured Transcript (segments, optional word timestamps, language, provenance) and SpeechEvent candidates out. Not an agent, not a subtitle renderer, not a media analyzer.

engines.description: Whisper via CTranslate2, running locally on CPU/GPU. Reference local engine.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: Haas-ja-v1.0 (Japanese FastConformer-TDT, NeMo) via haas-asr, running locally on an NVIDIA GPU. Optional engine: Linux + CUDA + Python 3.11+ only; Japanese only; custom vocabulary.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: speech.cpp (C++ on ggml) through its `speech` command: ReazonSpeech v2, parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja and Haas-ja-v1.0 for Japanese with word timestamps, and Qwen3-ASR in 30 languages, on Metal, Vulkan or the CPU with no Python and no CUDA. Optional engine: needs `speech` 0.10.0+ on PATH and models fetched with `speech pull`; recognizes by silero-vad regions; never downloads.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

engines.description: whisperX: Whisper (faster-whisper) batched over voice-activity regions, with wav2vec2 forced alignment for word timestamps. Optional engine: Python 3.10+, English and Japanese; no diarization.
engines.unavailable_reason: pinned snapshot: availability comes from the installed Skill's contract / doctor

tools.name: transcription/transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe an audio or video file into a validated Transcript.

input.speaker_turns: diarization-skill/turns@1 document | path | null (merged after recognition, never cached)

tools.name: transcription/segments
tools.description: Derive SpeechEvent-compatible candidates from a Transcript (one per segment, optional gap merge).

tools.name: transcription/export
tools.description: Render a Transcript as json, srt, vtt, tsv or txt (plain timed text, no styling).

tools.name: transcription/speakers
tools.description: Fill segments[].speaker_id (and words[].speaker_id) of a Transcript from diarization-skill speaker turns (diarization-skill/turns@1), with diarization-skill's own ASSIGN rule. No diarization here.

tools.name: transcription/check
tools.description: Validate a Transcript document against the contract.

tools.name: transcription/batch
tools.description: Run many transcription/transcribe requests in one process. One item's failure does not abort the others; each result is reported independently in order.

output.results: list[{ok: bool, result: transcription/transcribe output} | {ok: bool, error: {code, message, details}}]

side_effects: writes cache under workspace, once per item
